title: Warm range
brief: A labelled range slider look: Warmth with the value 70 percent, a dark track filled in coral up to a round thumb, and scale numbers below.

inspiration.note: Took a labelled slider with a value readout and a filled active track; our thumb is a ringed dot and the track is thin and flat.
Took the track, range and thumb as three separate parts; we added scale ticks and a bold value.
